lines: Yes... such power is wasted on a human, Igawa Asagi♪
Muroi-sensei, noーMuroi stepped over Gaiza and faced Asagi-sensei.
You must not be human... What are you?
I'm not obliged to answer your question, Asagi-san.
Then I'll force you to answer.
Hehe, what an arrogant woman you are. Even though you're a lowly human being. How very unpleasant.
Hey, wait... don't talk like I'm not here...
Gaiza slowly lifted himself from the bloodstained floor.
Shut up!! I can still... ugh...
Perhaps because of the armor, or maybe because Asagi-sensei had gone easy on him, Gaiza wasn't mortally wounded. But he still had wounds all over and must have been in a lot of pain.
However, Gaiza reached for his sword anyway.
The potion I gave you is about to wear off. Keep going like this and you really will die.
And we've achieved our purpose anyway.
Muroi took Gaiza and began to casually leave the headmistress's office.
You're not getting away that easily.
Asagi-sensei, who had been standing in front of her desk until just a second ago, had gone around behind Muroi in the blink of an eye. And thenー
Asagi-sensei swung her sword as easily as cutting through a piece of paper. Muroi crumbled into two lumps of flesh after being cut cleanly in half.
Even I couldn't look at the scene before me. Asagi-sensei, however, still didn't lower her guard.
Prodded by Shikanosuke, I looked toward Muroi and saw a swirling cloud of miasma rise above the lumps of flesh.
I-It's still not over? What's going on...!!!
Stop tugging! I don't know either!

The lumps of flesh that had been Muroi until a few moments ago seemed to get dissolved by the miasma. What at first just seemed to be a black fog eventually took human form and appeared as the figure of a man.
You are... Fürst...!!? Why is a senior executive of Nomad like you...
Fürst. I, too, had heard that name before.
A high-ranking demon and one of the senior executives of "Nomad," the remarkably fast-growing organization within the newly formed coalition of humans and demons.
He was also said to be an authority on "Devildomian medicine," researching abominable body modifications and evil drugs.
(So Gaiza strengthened his power by taking a drug he made...!)
(But why is someone like him is here at Gosha Academy in the first place?!)
Are you surprised that I, a senior executive of Nomad, infiltrated Gosha Academy? I'm sure you are, I'm sure you are.
Traces of Muroi could still be found in the expression of the laughing Fürst.
This is what I call a "Flesh Disguise," made possible by gathering the best of my Devildomian medical techniques.
Deceiving the eyes of you lowly humans is a simple task for someone as noble as me.
Lowly, lowly... just shut up, old man...
Aaah, my apologies. I forgot you were also a human. Oh-ho-ho...
So, Gaiza-san. No need to stay any longer. Let us return.
As Fürst waved his hand around, the miasma started to swirl until eventually a gaping, dark opening appeared.
Wait, Gaiza! Don't tell me that you joined forces with Nomad?
What are you planning to gain from that!? Is that the kind of Fuma Clan you want!? Answer me, Gaiza!!!
Gaiza's left eye looked this way for just a second and thenーhe disappeared with Fürst into the darkness.
Just as I jumped back upon hearing Hebiko's voice, the sound of growling accompanied the emergence of deformed creatures from the hole Gaiza and Fürst had just disappeared through.
So he's trying to stall us. Now we can't chase the two of them anymore. Anyway, let's take those monsters out!
